description: Public bike pumps is a dataset listed in Open Data Bristol, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Open Data Bristol. Datagov. Coverage: Bristol. Its keywords are Bristol City Council, local information, Cycling. The portal shows 28 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-04-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-bristol-gov-uk-portal.
